subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on December 15th, 2021. Your booking reference number is XYZ123. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels, The Flight Company
